I'm a senior data scientist at Stanford Health Care and MD/PhD candidate in Stanford's Medical Scientist Training Program (MSTP). I build, deploy, and monitor clinical AI systems — from LLM-powered chart abstraction to agentic tumor board preparation — and study how to do this safely at scale. My work spans applied machine learning, single-cell biology, and medical education.

**Currently:** finishing clinical clerkships, building on top of [ChatEHR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.00074), and writing up work on applications of agentic AI in clinical workflows.

[Read more →](bio.html)

```{r}
#| label: network-viz
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# ---- Interactive research interest network ----
library(visNetwork)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)

# ---- Define nodes: central node + domain clusters ----
nodes <- tribble(
  ~name,                       ~group,
  # Clinical AI cluster
  "Clinical AI",               "clinical_ai",
  "LLMs",                      "clinical_ai",
  "EHR Data",                  "clinical_ai",
  "AI Monitoring",             "clinical_ai",
  "Agentic AI",                "clinical_ai",
  "NLP",                       "clinical_ai",
  "CDS",                       "clinical_ai",
  "AI Governance",             "clinical_ai",
  "Patient Triage",            "clinical_ai",
  "Tumor Boards",              "clinical_ai",
  "Statistics",                "clinical_ai",
  # Single-cell cluster (9 nodes)
  "Single-Cell Biology",       "single_cell",
  "ML",                        "clinical_ai",
  "CyTOF",                     "single_cell",
  "DL",                        "clinical_ai",
  "scRNA-seq",                 "single_cell",
  "Data Integration",          "single_cell",
  "Leukemia",                  "single_cell",
  "Immunology",                "single_cell",
  "Bioinformatics",            "single_cell",
  "Precision Medicine",        "clinical_ai",
  # Open source cluster (5 nodes)
  "Open Source",               "software",
  "Tidy Data",                 "software",
  "R",                         "software",
  "Bioconductor",              "software",
  "Data Visualization",        "software",
  "Python",                    "software",
  # Medical education cluster (6 nodes)
  "Medical Education",         "med_ed",
  "Curriculum Design",         "med_ed",
  "Health Equity",             "med_ed",
  "Program Evaluation",        "med_ed",
  "CME",                       "med_ed",
  "Student Advocacy",          "med_ed"
)

# ---- Define edges ----
edges <- tribble(
  ~from,                    ~to,
  # Clinical AI internal edges
  "Clinical AI",            "LLMs",
  "Clinical AI",            "EHR Data",
  "Clinical AI",            "AI Monitoring",
  "Clinical AI",            "Agentic AI",
  "Clinical AI",            "NLP",
  "Clinical AI",            "CDS",
  "Clinical AI",            "AI Governance",
  "Clinical AI",            "Patient Triage",
  "Clinical AI",            "Tumor Boards",
  "Clinical AI",            "Statistics",
  "Clinical AI",            "ML",
  "LLMs",                   "Agentic AI",
  "LLMs",                   "NLP",
  "NLP",                    "EHR Data",
  "AI Monitoring",          "AI Governance",
  "Patient Triage",         "CDS",
  "Tumor Boards",           "Agentic AI",
  "Tumor Boards",           "CDS",
  "Statistics",             "AI Monitoring",
  "Leukemia",               "Tumor Boards",
  # Single-cell internal edges
  "Single-Cell Biology",    "Bioinformatics",
  "Single-Cell Biology",    "CyTOF",
  "Single-Cell Biology",    "scRNA-seq",
  "Single-Cell Biology",    "Data Integration",
  "Single-Cell Biology",    "Immunology",
  "Single-Cell Biology",    "Leukemia",
  "ML",                     "DL",
  "Leukemia",               "Immunology",
  "CyTOF",                  "Data Integration",
  "scRNA-seq",              "Data Integration",
  "Bioinformatics",         "ML",
  "Bioinformatics",         "Data Integration",
  # Precision Medicine bridges clinical AI and single-cell
  "Precision Medicine",     "CDS",
  "Precision Medicine",     "Bioinformatics",
  "Precision Medicine",     "Leukemia",
  "Clinical AI",            "Precision Medicine",
  # Open source internal edges
  "Bioinformatics",         "Tidy Data",
  "Open Source",            "Tidy Data",
  "Open Source",            "R",
  "Open Source",            "Bioconductor",
  "R",                     "Bioconductor",
  "Open Source",            "Data Visualization",
  "Tidy Data",              "CyTOF",
  "Tidy Data",              "Bioconductor",
  "Tidy Data",              "R",
  "Data Visualization",     "R",
  "Data Visualization",     "Python",
  # Medical education internal edges
  "Medical Education",      "Curriculum Design",
  "Medical Education",      "Health Equity",
  "Medical Education",      "Program Evaluation",
  "Medical Education",      "CME",
  "Medical Education",      "Student Advocacy",
  "CME",                    "Curriculum Design",
  "Program Evaluation",     "CME",
  "Student Advocacy",       "Health Equity",
  "Program Evaluation",     "Statistics",
  "Program Evaluation",     "AI Monitoring",
  "Program Evaluation",     "AI Governance",
  "R",                      "Statistics",
  "R",                      "LLMs",
  "Python",                 "Statistics",
  "Python",                 "LLMs",
  "Python",                 "Agentic AI",
  "Open Source",            "Python",
  # Cross-cluster bridge edges
  "ML",                     "AI Monitoring",
  "ML",                     "Statistics",
  "DL",                     "LLMs",
  "DL",                     "Clinical AI",
  "Health Equity",          "AI Governance",
  "Health Equity",          "AI Monitoring"
)

# ---- Color palette (Stanford-inspired) ----
group_colors <- c(
  "clinical_ai" = "#007C92",
  "single_cell" = "#E04F39",
  "software"    = "#53B17A",
  "med_ed"      = "#B26F16"
)

# Hub nodes are larger and bold
hub_nodes <- c("Clinical AI", "Single-Cell Biology", "Open Source",
               "Medical Education")

# ---- Build visNetwork node data frame ----
vis_nodes <-
  nodes |>
  mutate(
    id = row_number(),
    label = if_else(name %in% hub_nodes, name, ""),
    color = group_colors[group],
    size = if_else(name %in% hub_nodes, 35, 18),
    font.size = if_else(name %in% hub_nodes, 60, 52),
    font.bold = name %in% hub_nodes,
    font.color = group_colors[group],
    font.strokeWidth = 1,
    font.strokeColor = "#ffffff",
    borderWidth = 1,
    borderWidthSelected = 2,
    shadow = TRUE
  )

# ---- Build visNetwork edge data frame ----
vis_edges <-
  edges |>
  left_join(vis_nodes |> select(id, name), by = c("from" = "name")) |>
  rename(from_id = id) |>
  left_join(vis_nodes |> select(id, name), by = c("to" = "name")) |>
  rename(to_id = id) |>
  transmute(from = from_id, to = to_id, color = "rgba(150,150,150,0.3)")

# ---- Render interactive network ----
visNetwork(
  vis_nodes,
  vis_edges,
    height = "80vh",
  width = "100%"
) |>
  visPhysics(
    solver = "forceAtlas2Based",
    forceAtlas2Based = list(
      gravitationalConstant = -40,
      centralGravity = 0.005,
      springLength = 120,
      springConstant = 0.04,
      avoidOverlap = 0.5
    ),
    stabilization = list(iterations = 200)
  ) |>
  visInteraction(
    hover = TRUE,
    tooltipDelay = 0,
    tooltipStay = 0,
    navigationButtons = FALSE,
    zoomView = FALSE,
    dragNodes = TRUE
  ) |>
  visOptions(
    highlightNearest = FALSE,
    nodesIdSelection = FALSE
  ) |>
  visLayout(randomSeed = 42) |>
  visEvents(
    hoverNode = "function(params) {
      var network = this;
      var nodeId = params.node;
      var connectedNodeIds = network.getConnectedNodes(nodeId);
      var connectedEdgeIds = network.getConnectedEdges(nodeId);
      var activeSet = new Set(connectedNodeIds);
      activeSet.add(nodeId);

      var allNodes = network.body.data.nodes;
      var nodeUpdates = [];
      allNodes.forEach(function(node) {
        var isActive = activeSet.has(node.id);
        var origColor = node.origColor || node.color;
        // Store original color on first hover
        if (!node.origColor) {
          nodeUpdates.push({ id: node.id, origColor: origColor });
        }
        if (isActive) {
          nodeUpdates.push({
            id: node.id,
            color: origColor,
            label: node.name,
            font: { color: origColor, strokeWidth: 1, strokeColor: '#ffffff',
                    size: node.font.size || 40, bold: node.font.bold || false }
          });
        } else {
          nodeUpdates.push({
            id: node.id,
            color: 'rgba(200,200,200,0.3)',
            label: node.font.bold ? node.name : '',
            font: { color: node.font.bold ? 'rgba(180,180,180,0.5)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
                    strokeWidth: node.font.bold ? 1 : 0,
                    strokeColor: node.font.bold ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
                    size: node.font.size || 40, bold: node.font.bold || false }
          });
        }
      });
      allNodes.update(nodeUpdates);

      // Dim all edges, brighten connected ones
      var allEdges = network.body.data.edges;
      var edgeSet = new Set(connectedEdgeIds);
      var edgeUpdates = [];
      allEdges.forEach(function(edge) {
        edgeUpdates.push({
          id: edge.id,
          color: edgeSet.has(edge.id) ? 'rgba(100,100,100,0.6)' : 'rgba(200,200,200,0.08)'
        });
      });
      allEdges.update(edgeUpdates);
    }",
    doubleClick = "function() { this.fit(); }",
    blurNode = "function(params) {
      var network = this;
      var allNodes = network.body.data.nodes;
      var nodeUpdates = [];
      allNodes.forEach(function(node) {
        var origColor = node.origColor || node.color;
        nodeUpdates.push({
          id: node.id,
          color: origColor,
          label: node.font.bold ? node.name : '',
          font: { color: node.font.bold ? origColor : 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
                  strokeWidth: node.font.bold ? 1 : 0,
                  strokeColor: node.font.bold ? '#ffffff' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
                  size: node.font.size || 40, bold: node.font.bold || false }
        });
      });
      allNodes.update(nodeUpdates);

      // Restore all edges
      var allEdges = network.body.data.edges;
      var edgeUpdates = [];
      allEdges.forEach(function(edge) {
        edgeUpdates.push({ id: edge.id, color: 'rgba(150,150,150,0.3)' });
      });
      allEdges.update(edgeUpdates);
    }"
  )
```
